summary: Cedar Bench School District wants a mechanical contractor to remove two cast iron hot water boilers at Larkmoor Elementary School and install two high-efficiency condensing boilers with pumps, venting, gas piping and controls. The engineer's estimate is $380,000 to $450,000 and the work must be done in the summer recess, June 7 to August 6, 2027. Sealed bids are due at the District Purchasing Office by 2:00 p.m. on Thursday, March 18, 2027.

notes.text: The list of all subcontractors is due within 24 hours of the bid opening, not of the award, and bids are opened at the 2:00 p.m. deadline itself. It applies only to the apparent low bidder, but you need the list ready before you bid.
Work can only happen between June 7 and August 6, 2027, about two months, and liquidated damages of $500 per calendar day apply after August 6.

The District is removing the asbestos-containing insulation on the old boilers under a separate contract before June 7; it is not part of this work. The text does not say what happens to the August 6 completion date or the daily damages if that removal runs late.

Section 3 requires a Utah S350 HVAC Contractor license; item (c) asks only for a copy of the bidder's Utah contractor license without naming the classification. I read these as the same license, but the text does not say so.

All questions must go in writing to the Purchasing Agent, Imogen Tavares, at purchasing@cedarbench.example; bidders may not contact the engineer or school staff. Questions received after 5:00 p.m. on March 10 will not be answered, and late bids are returned unopened.
